description: FHIR R4 Patient resource — demographics and other administrative information about an individual or animal receiving care or other health-related services.

fields.label: Resource ID
fields.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource.

fields.label: Identifier
fields.description: An identifier for this patient. Business identifier such as MRN.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Whether this patient record is in active use. Many systems use this property to mark as non-current patients.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: A name associated with the individual.

fields.label: Gender
fields.description: Administrative gender — the gender that the patient is considered to have for administration and record keeping purposes. Values: male | female | other | unknown.

fields.label: Birth Date
fields.description: The date of birth for the individual.

fields.label: Deceased (Boolean)
fields.description: Indicates if the individual is deceased or not.

fields.label: Deceased Date Time
fields.description: Date and time of death for the individual.

fields.label: Telecom
fields.description: A contact detail (telephone, email, etc.) for the individual.

fields.label: Marital Status
fields.description: The patient's most recent marital (civil) status.

fields.label: Communication
fields.description: A language which may be used to communicate with the patient about his or her health.

fields.label: General Practitioner
fields.description: Patient's nominated care provider. Reference to Organization, Practitioner, or PractitionerRole.

fields.label: Managing Organization
fields.description: Organization that is the custodian of the patient record. Reference to Organization.

fields.label: Link
fields.description: Link to another patient resource that concerns the same actual person.
